operations.name: Peter Van Schaack

expected.charges: Refusing the oath of allegiance to the revolutionary state of New York.
expected.convicted: Banished by order of the commissioners for conspiracies (1778), without criminal trial.
expected.sentence: Banishment and seven years of exile in England (1778–1785).

operations.research_note: Life of Peter Van Schaack p120 documents Aug19,1778 interview with Clinton while en route from home to British-held NewYork after banishment; use August month for forced displacement, not Oct19 sailing to England as first exile. P389 records June10,1785 embarkation and July20 landing at NewYork; physical return endpoint July20, not restoration of citizenship in1784. NYSL and Columbia corroborate1778-1785 exile. No incarceration interval inferred and no biography/notes changed.
